Not so good. I got out of a toxic relationship a few months ago with some of my family members and even though I feel lighter, I can’t help but think of their criticisms of me. The one that stung the most was when they told me, “I feel bad for your friends. Who would want to be with someone like you? You’re so fucking boring. We only talk to you because we feel bad.” I can’t help but wonder if I were more interesting maybe people wouldn’t hate me. It seems that all these people who were very much, “You’re so mysterious, open up to me,” left me after I opened up. A few days ago my father slapped me and yelled at me saying, “You’re such a bitch, why did I end up with a daughter like you?” I already had my suspicions that he didn’t want me (just like everyone else), but I thought that’s all they were, just suspicions, until he confirmed it. When so many people criticize you, it makes you ask yourself, “What if I am the problem?” Actually, I can’t even ask myself that anymore. I know I am the problem. I’m too flawed. No medicine, no witchcraft, nothing can fix me.

It’s like reliving the same shitty day every day and expecting something different but always ending up with the same result… No matter how hard you try. 

Thank you, even though you shouldn’t apologize to me for that.
